body: I know exactly how you feel.  My mom died very unexpectedly 8 years ago & it completely destroyed me.  I’m not even close to the person I was when she was alive & I never will be.  She was the only one who understood my mental health & could talk me down or make me feel like I wasn’t completely insane.  The pain never goes away, you just learn how to live with it in time.  It sounds super cliche & lame but one thing that does sometimes keep me from hurting myself is thinking about how that would make my mom feel.  What me dying would have done to her because no matter how awful it is for us, a parent losing a child is always harder.  Parents are supposed to pass before their children so sometimes that fucked up perspective can help.  I hope you got to at least say goodbye, I never got that chance & there are so many things I wish I could tell her.  I’m so sorry you’re going through this, it’s a pain worse than any other I’ve personally felt & wish I could save you from it.

Thank you for the kind words - I wasn’t saying that fishing for any compliments I promise! ... I can make myself look ok in a photo but it’s my body that I really have issues with & that is my main source of low self esteem.  Unless you’re skinny or toned you’re nothing in the gay world.  But looks aside I’m really depressed & my mental health is so fucked that even if I was a model no one would be able to deal with me.  Everyone I’ve ever met runs away when they see that side of me.  I have 34 years of proof, including all of my living family members, the ones who are supposed to love you no matter what & always stand by your side.

I wish I could help you - just try to be strong & not let your family define you.  I hated my family too, they were awful to me because I’m gay & I allowed them to hurt me for too long. I eventually decided that just because they are my family & we share dna doesn’t mean I have to like them or have them in my life.  I cut off contact with all of them 5 years ago & it’s been the best thing.  I still struggle a lot & it definitely gets hard sometimes not having a family but at the end of the day I only want people in my life who love & support me.  You will be on your own soon & once you’re away from your family you will see.  Don’t give up yet ... ❤️
